data.body:
2026-09-07 afternoon. Plan review (async starters, polled via gate_status) on the four land-first stories: round 1 all BLOCK on grounding findings (premise, edit-set, test mechanics); revised. Round 2: bossy-poetic-polliwog (library annotations) and skaldic-paradoxal-huemul (seam-guard deletion) PASS and certified. Round 3: gunshy-symmetric-barnacle (reconciler package move) PASS and certified at 360d504f; helpless-carnelian-megaraptor (config shim removal) BLOCK on one remaining multi-line resolver import (tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:30-34) plus a self-found fail-open AC grep (\s is not POSIX ERE); fix drafted, round 4 next. Operator ruling: there is no limit on review rounds; the "three-round" note I had written into a scheduled poll and the scratch ledger was wrong and is corrected.

Experiments recorded on tickets: drain fix proven red-then-green and the bug shown live on main (7 marker-admitted mechanisms block every --update-stale); package-move dry run (C901 scores path-independent, complexity map must be re-sorted, lock rejects exactly 6 added keys); 29-key mechanism re-spell complete; MCP golden deterministic and depends on REBAR_MCP_READONLY not REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM; pytest-split writes durations under xdist; TID251/TID253 green on the current tip. Cross-epic overlap analysis posted ownership rules on nine stories; the single-owner story aware-obvious-sphinx now keeps the two mechanism-ratchet tests it would have deleted. Stale-cite corrections for six stories are running in a subagent.

Analysis for the operator's two questions recorded as idea doomed-soldierly-slothbear (77e3-28e2-31ec-47ec): no gate asks whether the system is simpler afterward (A1 advisory, mechanism ratchet never checks removal, completion verifier checks only stated criteria, tests invisible as complexity), with five classes of removed complexity mapped to specific missing checks; and the janitor's harm-based floor plus ticket-only output made it a net producer of mechanisms (evidence: RP-04 toggle and seam tests, 08-06 drift gate and CI lock, 08-29 tombstones and scanner incident chain), with a proposed split into a deletion-only tidying janitor with a per-run budget.
